rules.content:
/*
ms13089 ransomware
*/

rule ms13089_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.ms13089"
        description = "Detects ms13089 ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "ms13089" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "MS13089" ascii
        $onion  = "ms13089.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
